relations.quote: Each algorithm in the chain computes its transforms by the [Discrete Fourier transform and butterflies](dft-fft.md), which evaluates a coefficient list at roots of unity using logarithmically many levels of two-point butterfly operations.
Its cost is measured against the [The n log n optimality conjecture](nlogn-conjecture.md).
